findings.severity: required wording precision; no runtime/code defect
findings.quote: Ошибки клиента, обработчика, наблюдения, неизвестные идентификаторы, неучтённые и не вернувшиеся вызовы отсутствуют.
findings.condition: All eight measured cancellation calls carry nonempty client_error="context canceled" and handler_context_error="context canceled" in the primary profile. They are expected cancellation outcomes; the unexpected error counters remain zero.
findings.consequence: The unqualified statement that client/handler errors are absent is literally stronger than the preserved per-call fields and obscures expected cancellation classification.
findings.minimum_change: Say unexpected/other client or handler errors are absent; explicitly retain context canceled as the eight expected cancellation outcomes. No rerun or data edit is needed.

verified.measurement_scope: Whole process, warmed cache; no isolated-parser memory, no peak estimate from the cancellation baseline sample, no leak/causal improvement/full-suite/standalone-branch claim.

remaining_review_limits: This review reread the complete README and compared claimed numbers/version/timing/composition with the exact primary profile, stdout and Q receipt. It did not repeat root payload/call-ID qualification or run any benchmark.
Thirty-eight calls are distinct invocations within their case context; per-case IDs can recur across cases. No claim of globally unique bare ID strings is needed.
Historical fixture-generation/publication and every helper implementation were not independently requalified by executing them. This is a publication-claim review.
Direct Go child receipt is settled without timeout; this does not prove a whole compiler/runtime process-tree deadline. README does not claim that property.
mutations: Only this independent review report was written. Reviewed README, results, raw files and source were not changed; no remote/Go/Rust/native execution.
